# Z.ai (GLM)

GLM models. Coding Plan subscribers: use base URL https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4.

| | |
|---|---|
| Kind | Chat API (OpenAI-compatible): returns code that conductor applies |
| Cost | Paid, per token |
| Key | `ZAI_API_KEY` from https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list |
| Endpoint | `https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4` |
| Default model | `glm-5.3` |
| conductor name | `zhipu` |
| Provider docs | https://docs.z.ai/guides/develop/openai/python |
| Checked | 2026-11 |

## Set up

1. Create an API key: https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list
2. Add it to conductor. It asks for the key (hidden input), lets you pick a model, sends one test prompt and adds it to the `docs`, `test`, `review` and `ask` roles:
   ```bash
   conductor add zhipu
   ```
3. Check it any time:
   ```bash
   conductor doctor --live
   ```

Or click **Add** on its card in `conductor ui` → Providers.

## Without the wizard

Save the key (hidden input; or pipe it in):
```bash
conductor keys set ZAI_API_KEY
```

Then add this to `~/.config/conductor/config.json` (all projects) or `.conductor/config.json` (one project):
```json
{
  "providers": {
    "zhipu": {
      "type": "openai",
      "enabled": true,
      "baseUrl": "https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4",
      "apiKeyEnv": "ZAI_API_KEY",
      "model": "glm-5.3"
    }
  }
}
```
List models: `conductor models zhipu --all`. Put `zhipu` in any role's chain in `conductor ui` → Roles & fallback.

The variable name only tells conductor where to find the key; the provider never sees it. To use a key you already keep under another name, set `"apiKeyEnv": "YOUR_VAR"` on `zhipu`.

## Troubleshooting

- **401 / 403**: the key is wrong, expired, or still a placeholder. Run `conductor keys` to see where it comes from, then `conductor keys set ZAI_API_KEY`.
- **404 or "model not found"**: the model id changed. Pick a current one with `conductor models zhipu --all`.
- **429**: rate limit. conductor puts the provider on cooldown and moves to the next one in the chain; `conductor cooldown --clear zhipu` resets it.
- **Empty reply**: some free routes return nothing now and then; conductor retries once, then falls back.
